notes.title: Krosa, the troublemakers are not here anymore.
notes.content:
Hello guys, this is Gratesca studio.
It has been more than a year since the last time we communicated with all players, we were unable to publish Steam official announcements about "FAR AWAY" without publishing ownership. Unfortunately, Thermite Games, former publisher of "FAR AWAY", who had the direct right to update everything, didn't respond to duty either. We are deeply regretful for the situation.

Good news is, our lawsuit with Thermite Games was done in recent days, Gratesca has taken back the publishing right of "FAR AWAY", and we are honored to continue our service to you again! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865369/68d02838e004f4ea6bdd1fe85b10d27d9669b363.jpg
Let's talk about the result of our lawsuit briefly:
[olist]
 The court confirmed that the contract between Gratesca studio and Thermite Games was terminated since 17th April, 2023.
 The court confirmed that Thermite Games should transfer all the Steam rights of "FAR AWAY" back to Gratesca studio.
 Thermite Games should return part of the revenue share back to Gratesca since the contract was terminated.
 Thermite Games bears the full responsibilities of Kickstarter project refunds and the full responsibilities of finishing MoDian project.
[/olist]
We are currently working on several tasks, including:
First of all, "FAR AWAY" will bundle with "Noctuary", with an extra discount of 25%.
"Noctuary" is the second product of Gratesca studio after "FAR AWAY", and currently thumbed by 93% positive reviews.
Comparing to "FAR AWAY", "Noctuary" not only offers visual novel stories but also combined with action combat. It's a more aesthetic, fantasy, and even an absurd epic. As a collection of all Gratesca titles, we welcome players to purchase the bundle rationally.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865369/c77c3198f443b2c2bd5ac955a728ae60f6a8ffca.jpg

Next, the Steam summer sale will start on 28th June, the base game of "FAR AWAY" will be discounted by 55%, "THE ART STORY OF FAR AWAY" will be discounted by 35%; the base game of "Noctuary" will be available at a 35% discount and the soundtrack DLC and artbook DLC are free. These are all in historical low discount.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865369/1b0b85eb1fa3f5f6d82ab7f5761c5cbdc2db2a02.jpg
Last but not least, the story of "FAR AWAY" will be "staged" elsewhere.
We are pleased to announce that the "Noctuary" DLC will feature a guest appearance by Krosa. The "Noctuary" DLC (new stories, new controllable players, skip function...) will be released for free, players who have purchased "Noctuary" will be able to enjoy all DLCs without additional cost.

PS: We anticipate launching the international PC version of "FAR AWAY" in Q3~Q4 of this year (at which time, English will be implemented for free). For specific details, please follow Gratesca Studio's Twitter and the Steam store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865369/fee8c9215bcde445de27a3a7beed9bdd64e2f724.jpg
Above all, we appreciate all the players' support to Gratesca and "FAR AWAY" all along.
We will continue creating amazing and interesting entertainment products till we die. Please stay tuned!

Gratesca studio
2024.6.14

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865369/986f578a67fc4603efff397398eaf0bf59ff4b68.jpg

notes.title: 关于《海沙风云》的分销计划和维护阶段性总结
notes.content:
朋友们，《海沙风云》已经上线两周，游戏的发行也基本进入了稳定期。目前游戏销量约为22000套。接下来，我们会启动分销计划，尽量让更多的人去了解《海沙风云》，希望能够让一起交流分享的玩家们越来越多。

现游戏版本已经更新到了Ver 1.0.5。在这段时间，我们根据玩家反馈修复了不少问题，但遗憾的是还有一部分需求没法满足大家，在这里必须特别说明。

首先是“节点图直接跳转相应剧情段落”；我们知道大量玩家都热烈呼吁这一功能，但在此只能说一句非常抱歉！由于基础架构的问题，我们目前没有能力也没有工期保证在做出节点图跳转这一功能的同时，确定存读档的数据继承不会出问题。对于任何游戏来说，存档都是重中之重，我们绝对不能让玩家有存档出问题这种恼人的游戏体验。我们明白目前《海沙风云》的节点图相比同类作品的流程分支图，辨识性和实用性存在不足。这一点是经验也是教训，我们会在之后的作品中改进。

此外，Steam串流手机和平板的功能也没法保证能够稳定运行，这些问题还需要我们去扩充制作组自身的实力才能解决，在这里只能在此给大家道歉，并再次画个饼：下一款游戏里一定会尽力避免这些基础性的问题。

希望大家继续向我们反馈问题和提出你的意见建议。关于游戏的其他一些系统问题和常见问题处理方法，我们晚些时候会另发一篇文章说明。

感谢大家的支持！

红茶Games
2021/9/2

- 如果您在第一次打开游戏时，把游戏移动到第二显示屏，设置为全屏或无边框窗口以后，关闭游戏再次打开可能会崩溃。此为Unity2019引擎的Bug，暂时无法修复。如遇问题请尝试以下方法： 打开注册表，在以下路径（HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\HongChaGame\海沙风云）找到海沙风云的注册表地址，删除注册表中前缀为UnitySelectMonitor的文件，再尝试打开游戏；
- 若还有其他问题，请及时联系我们；

- 给各位玩家带来的不便，我们深表歉意！

红茶Games
2021/08/20

notes.title: 《海沙风云》问题反馈集中楼
notes.content:
《海沙风云》已于今天凌晨在Steam发行，首先感谢各位朋友对我们的热情支持。

同时我们也收到了不少玩家的反馈意见。比如：

1. 游戏对话界面右侧的侧边栏菜单不易被发现；

2. Steam自带的F12截图会触发事件导致有的地方（比如人物关系图卡片详情界面）不能截图；

3. After Story的ED staff部分地方有文字错误；

4. 剧本部分地方有错别字；

5. 手柄示意图部分提示按钮和实际功能的按钮不同；

对于以上反馈，我们预计在本周五的时候会进行一次更新，修复上述问题。

除了上面提到的，可能还存在着很多其他问题。请大家发现问题了在此留言反馈，或者将问题反馈发送到我们的邮箱：hongchagames@126.com，我们会持续关注并在后续的更新中修复。

红茶Games
